segments.t: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.
segments.note: 「him」は英語の補い

segments.t: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head,
segments.note: 「it」は στέφανον を受ける。「into a crown」は πλέξαντες のほぐし

segments.t: and dressed him in a purple garment.
segments.note: 「in」は περιέβαλον のほぐし

segments.t: They kept saying,
segments.note: 「kept」は未完了相の訳。ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτόν は「saying」に吸収

segments.t: “Hail, King of the Jews!”
and they kept slapping him.
segments.note: 「slapping」は ἐδίδοσαν ῥαπίσματα のほぐし

segments.t: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them,
“Behold, I bring him out to you,
that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
segments.note: 「basis for a charge」は αἰτίαν のほぐし

segments.t: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment.
segments.note: 「of thorns」は ἀκάνθινον のほぐし

segments.t: Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
segments.note: 主語（ピラト）は文脈から英語が補う

segments.t: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying,
“Crucify! Crucify!”
Pilate said to them,
“Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”
segments.note: 「basis for a charge」は αἰτίαν のほぐし

segments.t: The Jews answered him,
“We have a law,
and by our law he ought to die,
segments.note: 「our」は英語の補い

segments.t: because he made himself the Son of God.”
segments.note: 冠詞相当の「the」は英語の補い

segments.t: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus,
segments.note: 主語（ピラト）は英語が補う

segments.t: “Where are you from?”
But Jesus gave him no answer.
Pilate therefore said to him,
“Aren’t you speaking to me?
Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”
Jesus answered,
segments.note: αὐτῷ（2番）は WEB に現れない

segments.t: “You would have no power at all against me,
segments.note: 「at all」は οὐδεμίαν の強調

segments.t: unless it were given to you from above.
segments.note: 「it」は英語の補い

segments.t: Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”
At this, Pilate was seeking to release him,
segments.note: 「At this」は ἐκ τούτου のほぐし

segments.t: but the Jews cried out, saying,
“If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend!
segments.note: 「man」は τοῦτον への補い

segments.t: Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”
segments.note: 不定冠詞「a」は英語の補い

segments.t: When Pilate therefore heard these words,
he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat
segments.note: 「down」は ἐκάθισεν のほぐし。定冠詞は英語の補い

segments.t: at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”
segments.note: 「The Pavement」は Λιθόστρωτον の意訳

segments.t: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover,
segments.note: 「Day」は παρασκευή への補い

segments.t: at about the sixth hour.
He said to the Jews,
segments.note: 主語（ピラト）は英語が補う

segments.t: “Behold, your King!”
They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!”
segments.note: 「Away with him」は Ἆρον のほぐし

segments.t: Pilate said to them,
“Shall I crucify your King?”
The chief priests answered,
“We have no king but Caesar!”
So then he delivered him to them to be crucified.
So they took Jesus
and led him away.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文系の続き（καὶ ἀπήγαγον 相当）を含むがギリシャ語本文に無い

segments.t: He went out, bearing his cross,
to the place called “The Place of a Skull”,
segments.note: 「of a Skull」は Κρανίου のほぐし

segments.t: which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,
where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.
segments.note: 「on either side one」は ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐντεῦθεν のほぐし

segments.t: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross.
segments.note: 「it」は τίτλον を受ける

segments.t: There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”
segments.note: 「OF NAZARETH」は ὁ Ναζωραῖος のほぐし

segments.t: Therefore many of the Jews read this title,
for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city;
segments.note: 「was near」は ἐγγὺς ἦν

segments.t: and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate,
“Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’
but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”
Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part;
segments.note: 「Then」は οὖν の訳

segments.t: and also the tunic.
segments.note: 動詞は前セグメントの「took」を受ける

segments.t: Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
segments.note: 「without seam」は ἄραφος のほぐし。「the top」は τῶν ἄνωθεν のほぐし

segments.t: Then they said to one another,
“Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,”
segments.note: 「cast lots」は λάχωμεν のほぐし。「to decide」は τίνος ἔσται のほぐし

segments.t: that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says,
“They parted my garments among them.
They cast lots for my clothing.”
segments.note: 主語「They」は英語の補い

segments.t: Therefore the soldiers did these things.
segments.note: 「things」は ταῦτα への補い

segments.t: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
segments.note: 「wife」は ἡ τοῦ Κλωπᾶ への補い

segments.t: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother,
segments.note: 所有格「his」は英語の補い（τὴν μητέρα）

segments.t: “Woman, behold, your son!”
Then he said to the disciple,
“Behold, your mother!”
From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
segments.note: 「home」は τὰ ἴδια への補い

segments.t: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished,
segments.note: 「things」は πάντα への補い。「seeing」は εἰδὼς の訳

segments.t: that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said,
“I am thirsty!”
segments.note: 主語と繋辞は Διψῶ に含まれる

segments.t: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there;
segments.note: 「Now」は英語の補い

segments.t: so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
segments.note: 主語（彼ら）は英語が補う。「held it at」は προσήνεγκαν のほぐし

segments.t: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said,
“It is finished!”
segments.note: 主語と繋辞は Τετέλεσται に含まれる

segments.t: Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
segments.note: 「Then」は καὶ の訳。「gave up」は παρέδωκεν のほぐし

segments.t: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day,
so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath
(for that Sabbath was a special one),
segments.note: 「special」は μεγάλη の意訳。「one」は ἡμέρα への補い

segments.t: asked of Pilate
that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;
segments.note: μὲν（7番）は対比の標識で英語に現れない

segments.t: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.
segments.note: 「that he was」は τεθνηκότα のほぐし

segments.t: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear,
segments.note: 「with a spear」は λόγχῃ（具格）のほぐし

segments.t: and immediately blood and water came out.
He who has seen has testified,
and his testimony is true.
He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
segments.note: 「the truth」は ἀληθῆ のほぐし

segments.t: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled,
segments.note: 「things」は ταῦτα への補い

segments.t: “A bone of him will not be broken.”
Again another Scripture says,
“They will look on him whom they pierced.”
segments.note: 主語（彼ら）は Ὄψονται・ἐξεκέντησαν に含まれる

segments.t: After these things,
Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews,
segments.note: 「secretly」は κεκρυμμένος のほぐし

segments.t: asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body.
Pilate gave him permission.
segments.note: 「permission」は ἐπέτρεψεν のほぐし。「him」は英語の補い。直前の καὶ（27番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: He came therefore and took away his body.
Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night,
segments.note: 「Jesus」は αὐτόν を受けて英語が補う

segments.t: also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes,
about a hundred Roman pounds.
segments.note: 「Roman」は λίτρας への補い

segments.t: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices,
segments.note: 「in」は ὀθονίοις（具格）のほぐし

segments.t: as the custom of the Jews is to bury.
Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden.
segments.note: 主語（彼）は英語が補う

segments.t: In the garden was a new tomb
segments.note: 繋辞は英語が補う（ギリシャ語は名詞文）

segments.t: in which no man had ever yet been laid.
segments.note: 「man」は οὐδείς への補い。「ever」は οὐδέπω の強調

segments.t: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day
segments.note: 「Then」は οὖν の訳。「Day」は παρασκευήν への補い

segments.t: (for the tomb was near at hand),
segments.note: 「at hand」は ἐγγύς のほぐし

segments.t: they laid Jesus there.
segments.note: ἐκεῖ は文末の「there」に対応（ギリシャ語では文頭）
